summary: Hosted browser authentication and safe post-login continuation.

files.better-auth.server.ts: Existing Better Auth server configuration and delivery bindings.
files.login-return.ts: Validates same-origin browser paths for returning from sign-in to PKCE authorization; external destinations and login loops fall back to home.
files.login-return.test.ts: Behavior checks for preserved authorization query parameters and rejected unsafe destinations.
files.continue-with-email.ts: Unified password entry through Better Auth: sign in first, register only on invalid credentials, preserve existing-account and service errors; reports newly created accounts for name completion.
files.continue-with-email.test.ts: Behavior checks for existing accounts, new registrations, incorrect passwords, network failure and throttling.
